creator: ZOZO Research

fields.id: Original set_id; not a user wardrobe item ID
fields.date: Original outfit publication date, not an actual wearing or capture date
fields.value: Count of items in this outfit, including accessories
fields.memo: Derived summary; category IDs are preserved without guessing category names
fields.items: Original item and category IDs; integer price_jpy is the source item price
fields.likes: Cumulative likes at source collection; not daily changes or current popularity

selection.method: monthly quotas; round-robin across dates; newest numeric ID within each date

changes: Selected a month-balanced sample instead of newest-only records
Normalized and validated using the original collector
limitations: Historical posts, not current fashion trends
Seasons are Northern Hemisphere calendar-month groups, not verified garment suitability
Balanced sampling does not estimate natural posting frequency or market popularity
No raw photos or user identities included
